label: preparing
what: Freight and builder explicitly coordinated a surprise gathering for the mayor in the hall at eighteen on day 1, including lighting, provisions and a concealed reason for his arrival. Builder later reported lighting finished. Possibly connected to the mayor's fortieth year in office, but this purpose is not established. Innkeeper and baker were proposed collaborators, not confirmed knowing participants; secretary knew of an evening invitation but knowledge of the surprise is unproven. Watchman was asked to keep silence, but no observed agreement or assistance establishes knowing help. No recorded disclosure of the surprise to the mayor.
